newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK TANK MAKER AWAITS APPROVAL ON MALAYSIA DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK TANK MAKER AWAITS APPROVAL ON MALAYSIA DEAL.

text.p: A $500 million deal to supply Slovak-made tanks to Malaysia is stuck awaiting Kuala Lampur's final approval but could be completed by the end of the year, an official with the tank's maker said.

"The deal was verbaly agreed, but remains open because of recent elections in Malaysia and adjustless to the state budget," Jan Supala, technical director of Slovak tank producer ZTS TEES a.s. Martin, said on Wednesday.

"We hope the tank purchase will be officialy aproved by the Malaysian side by the end of this year, and budgeted for next year," Supala said at an arms trade exhibition in the West Slovak town of Trencin.
ZTS TEES, which produces a modernised version of the originally Soviet designed T-72 M tank, faced competitors for the Malaysian contract from Poland and Britain's Vickers Group.
